historical_record.description: The site was used as a surface parking lot for approximately 60 cars.

The City Planning Commission approved the Section 309 determinations of compliance and exceptions for an 8-story building with 50 dwelling units, approximately 19,550 square feet of office space, and 1,350 square feet of ground floor commercial space, with 6 Below Market Rate units.
The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use for parking in excess of the amount allowed as accessory, 58 off-street parking spaces, with 6 Below Market Rate units.
